about: Production rows the energy tiles read, as the three source tables a fake member client serves (see ./fixtures.ts), written by energyFixtureTables (./energy-tables.ts) from ./energy.rows.json: the latest 14 records of each MER series a tile reads (equal to EIA's CSVs record for record), the eGRID2023 and EIA-861 state cross-sections (equal to EPA's and EIA's workbooks) and every State cell of EIA-860's proposed storage table, read on production 26 Nov 2026 (energy report, round 6).
